intent: Build a restrained, reusable workspace frame that can hold a complete dashboard, report or settings page without imposing application data or a routing framework.

layout.description: The wide layout has a 188px navigation rail and a flexible main column. In containers narrower than 48rem the rail becomes a compact identity row with horizontal navigation. The main column has an editorial header, a spaced content area and an optional footnote.
layout.container: Responsive to the host container; narrow screens use a single column
layout.retainedViews: WorkspacePanels accepts activeId and panels with unique IDs and React content. Measure the active view, animate height, retain mounted drafts and make inactive content inert.
layout.headerControls: Header actions stack above main content; the shell does not clip dropdown menus.
layout.applicationNavigation: Controlled activeId and onNavigate render keyboard-accessible view tabs; retain ordinary routes and anchors when not supplied. Fixed-height shells keep the identity, navigation and header visible while the content pane scrolls.

color.dark: Near-black surfaces, neutral borders, off-white text
color.light: Warm neutral canvas, white surfaces, charcoal text
color.accent: Reserved for meaningful data or state

motion.entrance: Short opacity and small position changes

responsive.narrow: Stack content; keep actions and controls reachable
responsive.wide: Use a composed workspace with clear reading order

accessibility: Real section anchors and visible keyboard focus
Labelled native controls and useful status feedback
Preserve each underlying component keyboard contract

integration: Pass real routes or unique section anchors through `links`. Navigation reflows from a sidebar to a horizontal strip based on the shell container.
Place your page panels in `children` and host actions in `actions`. The shell owns presentation; each supplied panel keeps its interaction and data contract.
